signature: setFog(options?: { color?, near?, far?, visible? }): void

params.name: options
params.type: { color?: IColor, near?: number, far?: number, visible?: boolean }

code: ssp.sceneTool.setFog({ color: '#aaccff', near: 100, far: 800, visible: true });
example: ssp.sceneTool.setFog({ color: 0xcce0ff, near: 200, far: 1200, visible: true });
